content_sections.heading: SRCC Teaching Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the SRCC Teaching Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download SRCC Teaching Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: SRCC Teaching Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: SRCC Recruitment 2026 includes vacancies for Assistant Professor posts across different departments and one vacancy for Director Physical Education (DPE). The Assistant Professor vacancies are mentioned in the SRCC notification for Commerce, Economics and Mathematics departments. SRCC has invited applications for one post of Director, Physical Education (DPE) in Pay Level-10.

rows.date: Two weeks from the date of publication of advertisement in Employment News or as mentioned on the official website

content_sections.heading: SRCC Teaching Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for SRCC Assistant Professor and Director Physical Education posts must satisfy the educational qualifications and other eligibility requirements prescribed by the University of Delhi and UGC.

content_sections.heading: SRCC Assistant Professor Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade from a recognized university. Candidates must fulfil UGC eligibility requirements. NET conducted by UGC/CSIR is required unless exempted according to applicable UGC rules. Ph.D. holders fulfilling UGC regulations may also be considered as per applicable provisions.

content_sections.heading: SRCC Director Physical Education Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Physical Education and Sports or Physical Education or Sports Science with 55% marks. Record of representing University/College at inter-university/inter-collegiate competitions or State/National championships. NET qualification as applicable. Must have passed the prescribed physical fitness test. Alternatively, candidates who are Asian Games or Commonwealth Games medal winners with a degree at least at Post-Graduate level may also be considered.

content_sections.heading: SRCC Teaching Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: The Director Physical Education post is mentioned with Pay Level-10 in the recruitment notification.

rows.salary_details: As per University of Delhi / 7th CPC Pay Matrix

content_sections.heading: SRCC Teaching Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee should be paid through online mode.

content_sections.heading: SRCC Teaching Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process includes screening and shortlisting of applications followed by further selection stages as per University of Delhi guidelines. Application Screening Shortlisting of Candidates Interview / Presentation Assessment The screening process considers academic record, research publications, teaching/post-doctoral experience and other prescribed criteria. The selection process for Director Physical Education includes a written examination and further selection stages.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SRCC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply online for SRCC Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below: Visit the official SRCC website. Open the recruitment application link. Register and complete the application form. Upload required documents and certificates. Pay the application fee if applicable. Submit the application form and keep a copy for future reference. Candidates should read the official notification and screening guidelines before submitting the application.

faq.question: Q1. What is SRCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SRCC Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Shri Ram College of Commerce, University of Delhi for Assistant Professor and Director Physical Education posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in SRCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 vacancies are available, including 16 Assistant Professor posts and 1 Director Physical Education post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for SRCC Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Master's Degree with 55% marks and fulfil UGC eligibility requirements.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for SRCC Director Physical Education Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Master's Degree in Physical Education/Sports Science with 55% marks along with required sports participation and eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date for SRCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is two weeks from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News or as mentioned by SRCC.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for SRCC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official SRCC application portal.
